title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — November 05, 2026

Today’s elevated solar activity makes the outer corona worth a look.

🔥 Strongest recent flare: M3.5

Watching the corona today. 👀

A broad coronal-hole region stands out today, alongside several bright active regions and a few small sunspot groups.

Image: NOAA SWPC — LASCO C3
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
